# FiDi Mezzanine

> FiDi Mezzanine is a full service event venue at 55 Broadway, New York, NY 10006, in Manhattan's Financial District. It covers 6,300 square feet and holds up to 400 guests standing or 150 guests for a seated dinner. Catering, bar, decor, staging and production are handled in house by the MMEink team.

## Venue facts
- Name: FiDi Mezzanine
- Address: 55 Broadway, New York, NY 10006
- Neighborhood: Financial District (FiDi), Lower Manhattan
- Size: 6,300 square feet
- Capacity: up to 400 guests standing, up to 150 guests seated for dinner
- Style: industrial chic, floor to ceiling windows, designer lounge furniture, chandeliers, bleacher style seating
- Features: in-house kitchen, surround sound audio, private call booths, two multi-person bathrooms
- Operated by: MMEink

## Spaces
- Main Bar
- Lobby
- Reading Room
- Conference Room
- Dining Room
- Meeting Room
Each space can be used on its own or together with the others.

## Event types
- Corporate events: conferences, product launches, company parties, corporate galas
- Weddings: ceremonies and receptions
- Private parties: birthdays, anniversaries, milestone celebrations
- Film and TV shoots

## Catering and services
- Full in-house catering and bar service
- Event decor and design
- Staging, production and entertainment
- Event coordination and day-of management
Clients work with one team from start to finish instead of coordinating separate vendors.

## Location and transit
- Steps from Wall Street, close to the New York Stock Exchange, Bowling Green and Battery Park
- Subway: Bowling Green (4/5), Wall Street (2/3 and 4/5), Rector Street (1 and R)
